title_sq: Vile 3-kateshe per Shitje, Collina Verde, Lunder!
description_sq:
Vile 3-kateshe per shitje te Collina Verde, ne Lunder!
Collina Verde është një kompleks rezidencial i krijuar posaçërisht për ëndrrën tuaj. Kompleksi është ndërtuar shumë afër kryeqytetit, mes qetësisë dhe ajrit të pastër që ofrojnë kodrat e buta të Farkës Collina Verde shtrihet në gjelbërimin e kodrave të Lundrës, pranë kompleksit rezidencial "Rolling Hills"
Vilat jane te ndertuara sipas standarteve bashkekohore, me fasade te dekoruara me sistem termoizolimi.
Magjia e vilave përcillet përmes tipologjive të ndryshme, ku secila prej tyre është një eksperiencë e ndryshme. Oborri i vilave ofron mundesi parkimi deri ne 2 automjete dhe mundesi per pishine personale ne disa tipologji te ofruara.
Ne kete vile ndodhen 3 kate. Ne katin 0 te kesaj vile, ofrohet nje siperfaqe prej 153.7 m2, ne katin e 1-re te saj, siperfaqja eshte 193.1 m2, ndersa ne katin e 2-te ajo ka nje siperfaqe prej 153.8 m2. Vila ofron 6 dhoma gjumi, 1 sallon, 1 kuzhine dhe 7 tualete. 
Vlen per tu permendur se ne vile jane bere investime totalisht nga e para, duke nisur nga tullat, parketi, pllakat, tjegullat, dopio xham me kasa, instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike,te cilat kane nje vlere rreth 150,000 euro.
Vila ka mundesi riorganizimi ne vile twin, pra dy vila te bashkangjitura.
*Vila jepet bosh*
title_en: 3-storey villa for sale, Collina Verde, Lunder!
description_en: 3-storey villa for sale in Collina Verde, in Lunder! Collina Verde is a residential complex specially designed for your dream. The complex is built very close to the capital, between the calmness and fresh air offered by the gentle hills of Farka, Collina Verde lies in the greenery of the hills of Lundra, near the "Rolling Hills" residential complex. The villas are built according to contemporary standards, with facades decorated with a thermal insulation system. The magic of the villas is conveyed through different typologies, where each of them is a different experience. The yard of the villas offers parking for up to 2 vehicles and the possibility for a personal swimming pool in some typologies offered. There are 3 floors in this villa. On the 0th floor of this villa, an area of ​​153.7 m2 is offered, on the 1st floor, the area is 193.1 m2, while on the 2nd floor it has an area of ​​153.8 m2. The villa offers 6 bedrooms, 1 living room, 1 kitchen and 7 bathrooms. It is worth mentioning that investments were made in the villa from scratch, starting with bricks, parquet, tiles, double glazing, electrical and plumbing installations, which have a value of around 150,000 euros. The villa can be rearranged into a twin villa, that is, two attached villas. *The villa is offered empty*
